gameHistory.title: Talent Show
gameHistory.prose: The maxi challenge was Talent Show Extravaganza, and the runway category was Bodysuit Realness. Minnie Skurr won the maxi challenge, Quin was high, and Minnie Skurr and Quin lip synced to "So Emotional."

gameHistory.title: The Ball
gameHistory.prose: The maxi challenge was The Ball, and the runway category was Two Looks in One. Ginger Hollywood won the maxi challenge, Quin and Cupcakke were high, Riot was low, Marge Stache was in the bottom, Anita Crown Davenport and Marge Stache lip synced to "Holding Out for a Hero," and Marge Stache was sashayed away.

gameHistory.title: Acting Challenge
gameHistory.prose: The maxi challenge was Acting Challenge, the runway category was Something Borrowed, and Quin won the mini challenge. Paige Turner won the maxi challenge, Quin and Cupcakke were high, Cheryl Hole was low, Taystee was in the bottom, Minnie Skurr and Taystee lip synced to "9 to 5," and Taystee was sashayed away.

gameHistory.title: Commercial Challenge
